question: What complexion and seat characterize the goddess Candrāvalī in this iconographic description?
premises: Candrāvalī is described as having a golden radiance.
Candrāvalī is described as seated on a black-antelope deer seat.
inference: Candrāvalī is iconographically identified as golden-hued and seated upon a black-antelope deer.
uncertainties: Whether mṛga-āsanā refers to a seat made of black-antelope skin or to sitting upon the deer itself is not fully explicit.
plain_english: And Candrāvalī, golden in radiance, is seated on a black-antelope deer.
